facts.text: Under the Oswego Guarantee, the university caps annual on-campus housing and meal plan increases at 5% and guarantees that if a required course is unavailable for on-time four-year graduation, the remaining courses will be provided tuition-free.

sources.title: Oswego Guarantee | SUNY Oswego
sources.quote: We guarantee that the cost of on-campus housing and meal plans will increase no more than 5% each year.

sources.title: Oswego Guarantee | SUNY Oswego
sources.quote: If you meet these expectations and cannot graduate after four years because of course unavailability, we will enroll you in the remaining course or courses necessary to meet graduation requirements tuition-free.
